sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl./ Prin. Secy., Deptt. Of Food Safety And Drug Adm Counsel for Petitioner :- Rahul Kapoor,Gaurav Mehrotra,Shhreiya Agarawal Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,A.S.G.I.,Ambrish Rai Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
Heard Sri Gaurav Mehrotra, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Abhishek Dhaon, learned Additional C.S.C. for the State and Sri Ambrish Rai, learned counsel for the opposite party No.2.
A copy of the lab report dated 12.02.2025 has been provided to the learned counsel for the petitioner today by Sri Abhishek Dhaon, learned Additional C.S.C. for the State.

After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the petitioner fairly submitted that he will avail the remedy of appeal prescribed under Section 46 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 but a direction for its expeditious disposal be granted.
Further, the interim relief application be also ordered to be decided within a week.

sentences.text: We, accordingly, dispose of this Writ Petition with liberty to the petitioner to file the appeal as per law before the appellate authority, whereupon the same shall be considered and decided as early as possible, say, within two months.
In the interregnum, if it is otherwise permissible, the interim relief application, if any, filed by the petitioner, may also be considered and decided within ten days of its filing.
Sri Abhishek Dhaon, learned Additional C.S.C. for the State shall communicate this order for compliance to the appellate authority and the opposite party No.4.
